latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.19

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.19. The engines (`strata-engine`, the new `strata-inkling` shape engine, and the updated Linux SYCL `strata-hy4` package) are 0.1.65, and so is Control, the program that installs and updates them. The update feeds are sequence 131 (shared) and 127 (`linux-aarch64`).

## What changes for you

- **Native Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Mini support (`strata-inkling` 0.1.65).** Run Thinking Machines Lab's 26.4B-parameter looped Mixture-of-Experts model (`3.4B` active per token / `5.4B` looped-active across 48 virtual visits, up to `1M` context, text + image inputs, OpenAI-compatible tool calling, direct non-thinking answers) locally across Windows, Linux, macOS Apple Silicon, Intel Arc, and NVIDIA DGX Spark (`linux-aarch64`).
- **Three Strata Quantization packs ([`strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata`](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata))**, starting from a **4 GiB graphics card**:
  - **SQ-10** (`10.47 GB` / `9.75 GiB`): fits 100% in VRAM on **12 GiB** cards, **16 GiB** Macs, and Radeon 780M / Strix Point iGPUs (and runs in hybrid RAM+VRAM mode from **4 GiB** GPUs).
  - **SQ-15** (`14.35 GB` / `13.36 GiB`): fits 100% in VRAM on **16 GiB** cards and **24 GiB** Macs (`96.68%` top-1 agreement with the original weights, `0.00889` test KL divergence).
  - **SQ-20** (`19.35 GB` / `18.02 GiB`): **bit-exact lossless** native `SF4+MX8` build for **24 GiB+** GPUs and **32 GiB+** unified memory (`100.00%` top-1 agreement and `0.00000` KL divergence on held-out test prompts and WikiText-2).
  - **Vision (`Inkling-2-Mini-Vision.strata`, `0.64 GB` lossless BF16)** and **built-in `W=4` Multi-Branch On-GPU Markov Beam Tree `DSpark` speculative decoding** work out of the box in both the Desktop app and `strata launch`.
  - **Direct `safetensors`, `.gguf`, and Dual-GPU EP support:** `strata-inkling` also loads official `thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini` `safetensors` (`+ mtp.safetensors`) and community `.gguf` files directly, with `--gpus 2` Dual-GPU Expert Parallelism and CUDA-Graph mapped-memory doorbell NUMA offload.
- **15 ready-made `strata-inkling` 0.1.65 packages** in `shape_engines`, fetched automatically on demand when you choose Inkling 2 Mini:
  - **Windows `x86_64`:** `cuda-cuda13`, `cuda-cuda12`, `hip-strix` (`gfx1151`), `hip-rx9070` (`gfx1200`/`gfx1201`), `hip-rdna3` (`gfx1100`–`gfx1150`, including Radeon 780M & Strix Point iGPUs), `hip-rdna2` (`gfx1030`–`gfx1032`).
  - **Linux `x86_64`:** `cuda-cuda13`, `cuda-cuda12`, `hip-halo` (`gfx1151`), `hip-rx9070`, `hip-rx7900` (`gfx1100`–`gfx1150`), `hip-rx6000`, and unified fat `sycl` (Intel Arc A-series & Battlemage B-series).
  - **macOS `arm64`:** `metal` (Metal 3 & Metal 4 `simdgroup_matrix` + barrier-free GEMV, signed & Apple-notarized).
  - **Linux `aarch64`:** `cuda-cuda13` (NVIDIA Grace Blackwell / DGX Spark GB10).
- **Faster Qwen3.8-Flash-Next out of the box on NVIDIA Blackwell, RTX 40, RTX 30, and AMD RDNA3 (`strata-engine` 0.1.65, zero environment variables needed).**
- **Update as usual.** Your existing Qwen, Hy4-Flash, and DeepSeek models, chats, and settings stay untouched.

## Engine & performance highlights

- **Inkling 2 Mini (`strata-inkling` 0.1.65):**
  - **Sparse-MoE Bayes-Optimal `W=4` On-GPU Markov Beam Tree `DSpark` + Zero-Logits-D2H serving (`0.00000` KLD):** reaches up to **250.3 tok/s** solo (`198.9 tok/s` on lossless `SQ-20`), **11,306 tok/s** prompt prefill, and **4,089.7 tok/s** total output across **64 concurrent requests** on RTX 5090; **154.4–214.5 tok/s** on RTX PRO 5000; **131.6 tok/s** (`2,081.1 tok/s` @ `c=32`) on `2x RTX PRO 6000` (`--gpus 2` EP); **108.9–114.5 tok/s** on Apple M5 Max 128 GB; **99.0–106.5 tok/s** on Radeon AI PRO R9700 (`+66%..+78%`); **47.3–48.0 tok/s** on Ryzen AI Max+ Strix Halo 128 GB (`+46%..+64%`); **74.3 tok/s** (`1,145.1 tok/s` @ `c=64`) on DGX Spark GB10; and **159.2 tok/s** on Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB.

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.19-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.19-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.19-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata.
